title.narrative: Skills for Future Economy Sector Development Program (Subprogram 1)

description.narrative: The sector development program (SDP) is part of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) support to the Government of Cambodia to strengthen human capital and transform the country into a technology-driven, knowledge-based industrial economy. It combines a programmatic PBL approach with a project investment to achieve strategically sequenced structural and institutional reforms in technical and vocational education and training (TVET), which includes increased private sector involvement to address skills gaps and shortages. The SDP will improve employability of the current and future labor force through policy reforms and project investments that will mutually reinforce each other to enhance the skills development ecosystem, deliver industry-led inclusive training, and mobilize more resources for demand-driven skills development.
